topic: A person finds out their surprise party has been cancelled
text: You think a nice surprise party's the cure for all ills. Hell, I've seen people go to great lengths to throw one. Thing is, life has a way of pulling the rug from under you when you least expect it. Got a message from my sister today. Her voice, it was different on the other end. Flat, almost. The party, she said, ain't happening. Supplies ran short, or the money dried up, something vague like that. Folks cancelling, so it's better to call it off. That's the story. I can feel the weight of unspoken words, like the ghosts of broken plans haunting the dim alleys of my mind. You start to wonder, what else isn't being said. What hidden turns lie ahead.
